create_sse_client: create an SSEClient instance from an HTTP response binary stream to consume server-sent events
consume_sse_events: consume server-sent events by iterating over the SSEClient events() generator yielding Event objects
parse_sse_event_data: parse multi-line SSE data fields and strip trailing newlines from event data payloads
close_sse_connection: close the SSEClient event source stream to release the underlying HTTP connection
build_event_object: build an Event object with id, event type, data, and retry interval fields for SSE event representation
